task: Fix Windows install.ps1 so benign npm stderr captured via 2>&1 in Get-PackageVersion does not abort under global $ErrorActionPreference='Stop' (EPMCDME-16967).

key_reasoning.reason: Single Get-PackageVersion function in install.ps1, but no exact precedent in repo; $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference is PS 7.3+ only while Windows PowerShell 5.1 is default, and no Pester tests exist, so verification is manual. Scored M, not higher, since the change is small and trivially reversible.
Bug and root cause are clear; minor open question on supported PowerShell versions and whether stdout/stderr should be separated so the returned version is not warning text.
